source: STEP 1 (Wilding et al., N Engl J Med 2021): 86.4% of the semaglutide 2.4 mg arm achieved at least 5% weight loss at week 68, against a mean change of -14.9%. `regain_per_year` is seeded at zero on the strength of STEP 5, which held roughly -15% out to 104 weeks on continued therapy — so on-treatment regain is a stated assumption of none rather than an unexamined default. It is exposed as an editable input precisely because a payer may not accept it: raise it and every avoided-event count from year 2 falls.
SURMOUNT-1 (Jastreboff et al., N Engl J Med 2022): 91% of the tirzepatide 15 mg arm achieved at least 5% weight loss at week 72, against a mean change of -20.9%. Regain treated as for semaglutide.
SCALE Obesity and Prediabetes (Pi-Sunyer et al., N Engl J Med 2015): 63.2% of the liraglutide 3.0 mg arm achieved at least 5% weight loss at week 56, against a mean change of -8.0%.
